Database.// Provider: Sqlite for local development and pilot, SqlServer for Azure SQL.

DataProtection.// Purpose: Required once the app runs on more than one App Service instance.

Seed.// AdminPassword: Empty on purpose. Set it per environment (appsettings.Development.json, user-secrets, or App Service settings). With no password NO administrator account is created and admin sign-in is impossible.
Seed.// ResetAdminPassword: Set true for one run to force the seeded admin password back to Seed:AdminPassword when you have lost it.
